twelve_physics_simulations.name: 1. 360° Horizon Obstruction & Multi-Height Solar Ray-Caster
twelve_physics_simulations.raw_input_crunched: 1m LiDAR DEM (10km terrain radius) + 1m LiDAR DSM (150m local buildings & trees)
twelve_physics_simulations.unopinionated_vector_output: 16-sector horizon angle array (deg) at +0m, +3m, +6m, +10m + Sky-View Factor (SVF) + Solstice/Equinox sun-hour grid

twelve_physics_simulations.name: 2. 7-Threshold Parametric Pad-Slope & Prismoidal Cut/Fill Curve
twelve_physics_simulations.raw_input_crunched: 1m LiDAR DEM minus Layer 101292 Buildings minus Layer 50782 Easements
twelve_physics_simulations.unopinionated_vector_output: Usable pad (m²), max inscribed rectangle (W×L m), and cut/fill volumes (m³) at [1°, 2°, 4°, 6°, 8°, 12°, 15°] slope caps

twelve_physics_simulations.name: 3. Hydro-Enforced D-Infinity Micro-Watershed & Ponding Spill Simulator
twelve_physics_simulations.raw_input_crunched: 1m LiDAR DEM across the local street sub-catchment
twelve_physics_simulations.unopinionated_vector_output: Upslope contributing catchment area (m²), overland entry/exit XY vectors, peak Q100 sheet flow (L/s), and depression spill depth (m)

twelve_physics_simulations.name: 4. 3D RANSAC Roof-Facet, Neighbour Wall & Overhead Wire Catenary Extractor
twelve_physics_simulations.open_source_engine: PDAL + SciPy Spatial RANSAC Plane & Catenary Fitting
twelve_physics_simulations.raw_input_crunched: Raw classified LiDAR `.laz` point cloud + LINZ Building Outlines
twelve_physics_simulations.unopinionated_vector_output: 3D roof facet polygons (pitch deg, azimuth deg, area m²), neighbour facing wall height profile, and overhead drop-wire sag clearance (m)

twelve_physics_simulations.name: 5. 3D Recession-Plane Polyhedron & Differential Neighbour Shadow Intersector
twelve_physics_simulations.raw_input_crunched: Parcel boundary + Neighbour LOD2 3D meshes + HIRB plane angles (45°/60°)
twelve_physics_simulations.unopinionated_vector_output: Max buildable 3D polyhedron volume (m³) + shadow cast breakdown (m²·hrs falling on neighbour roof vs. blank garage wall vs. living window)

twelve_physics_simulations.name: 6. Multi-Main 3D Trench Path & Hydraulic Grade-Line (HGL) Solver
twelve_physics_simulations.raw_input_crunched: 1m LiDAR DEM + All Council Wastewater/Stormwater Mains & Manholes within 100m
twelve_physics_simulations.unopinionated_vector_output: For each candidate main within 100m: trench length (m), max trench excavation depth (m), invert fall (m), and achieved gradient ratio

twelve_physics_simulations.name: 7. AS/NZS 1170.2 Directional Topographic Wind Multiplier (Mt / Mlee) Simulator
twelve_physics_simulations.raw_input_crunched: 1m/8m DEM elevation rays across 8 compass octants (2,000m upwind fetch) + BRANZ Wind Region
twelve_physics_simulations.unopinionated_vector_output: 8-octant hill-shape multiplier (Mh), lee-zone multiplier (Mlee), terrain-height multiplier (Mz,cat), and ultimate design wind speed (m/s)

twelve_physics_simulations.name: 8. 3D Fresnel-Barrier Acoustic Propagation Field (Road, Rail & Heat-Pump dBA)
twelve_physics_simulations.open_source_engine: ISO 9613-2 / CoRTN Vectorized Acoustic Attenuation Kernel
twelve_physics_simulations.raw_input_crunched: Waka Kotahi ADT & HCV% + KiwiRail NIMT offset + 1m LiDAR DSM building barriers
twelve_physics_simulations.unopinionated_vector_output: Daytime LAeq(24h) and nighttime Lmax noise levels (dBA) at [+1.5m ground, +4.5m L1, +7.5m L2] across the buildable pad

twelve_physics_simulations.name: 9. Boulanger-Idriss CPT Liquefaction & Reconsolidation Settlement Integrator
twelve_physics_simulations.open_source_engine: NumPy Depth-Integral CPT Liquefaction Kernel (Zhang et al. 2002 / Boulanger & Idriss 2014)
twelve_physics_simulations.raw_input_crunched: NZGD 0–20m CPT qc/fs/u2 traces + GWRC 20-year winter/summer groundwater bore depths
twelve_physics_simulations.unopinionated_vector_output: Liquefaction Severity Number (LSN) and vertical settlement (mm) matrix across [25yr SLS, 100yr, 500yr ULS] × [winter vs. summer water table]

twelve_physics_simulations.name: 10. 1942–2025 Multi-Epoch Stereo Photogrammetric Cut/Fill & Shoreline Diff
twelve_physics_simulations.open_source_engine: OpenCV / OpenDroneMap Stereo Disparity + GDAL DEM Subtraction
twelve_physics_simulations.raw_input_crunched: Retrolens 1942/1966/1985 overlapping stereo aerial pairs vs. 2025 1m LiDAR DEM
twelve_physics_simulations.unopinionated_vector_output: Historical elevation delta grid (ΔZ m), anthropogenic fill volume (m³), fill placement decade, and vanished channel centreline WKT

twelve_physics_simulations.name: 11. Kinematic Bicycle-Model Swept-Path & Crane Outrigger Clearance Simulator
twelve_physics_simulations.open_source_engine: Shapely / NumPy Ackermann Steering Kinematic Envelope Solver
twelve_physics_simulations.raw_input_crunched: Road reserve width + Berm pole/sump obstacles + Driveway/ROW polygon geometry
twelve_physics_simulations.unopinionated_vector_output: Min turning radius (m), pass/fail clearance margin (m) for [B85 Car, 8m Rigid Truck, 12.6m FENZ Fire Appliance], and crane outrigger box (m×m)

twelve_physics_simulations.name: 12. Slope-Weighted Network Graph Isochrones (Tobler Pedestrian & HPMV Haulage)
twelve_physics_simulations.raw_input_crunched: OpenStreetMap / LINZ Road & Footpath Graph weighted by 1m LiDAR longitudinal grade (%)
twelve_physics_simulations.unopinionated_vector_output: Exact grade-adjusted walk times (mins) and HPMV truck haul distances (km) to rail, sheltered bus, schools, hydrants, concrete plants & cleanfills
